title: zakhmi hai fatima tooti hai pasliyaa
body:
Haaye..
Darr jal chuka hai Yusuf e Zahra kab aaoge?
Zahra sadaein deti hai, Maula kab aaoge?
Al ajal, Al ajal
Al ajal, Al ajal, Al ajal
